title: Bakɛngɛli ya Elanga
intro: Na elanga moko ya kitoko, bato ya mboka moko balapaki ndai ya lokumu. Kasi ekateli na bango emekamaki ntango bolingi ya bonzambe ekɔtaki, mpe ebongolaki bozwi na bango na mokili ya kobota.
clues: Topambolamaki na elanga ya ebele, kasi tokómaki na lolendo.
Tosalaki mwango ya kobuka mbuma kozanga kokabola na babola.
Tobandaki mobembo na ntɔngɔntɔngɔ, totyaki elikya na mwango na biso.
Kasi ntango tokómaki kuna, tomonaki ete elanga na biso ebebaki na butu moko.
Tososolaki libunga na biso mpe tobandaki kopesana foti.
Nsukansuka toyambolaki, kasi liteya ezwamaki na retare mingi.

trial.label: Momekano/Evenement
options: Limpinga ya bandɛkɛ oyo ezali kobundisa
Mopɛpɛ monene oyo elongolaki banzete na misisa

outcome.label: Resultat
options: Bayambolaki kasi babungisaki elanga na bango
outcome.answer: Bayambolaki kasi babungisaki elanga na bango

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
